primary_metric: Mean over all18 parameter tasks of each task's maximum true-term relative coefficient error. Missing selected terms retain100% error; failed conditions are never removed.
structure_guard: For each noise and each guard budget, candidate exact count must be at least that of fixed-rich and rich-then-variance, and extra/missing totals must not exceed either control.
terminal_tail_guard: For each noise, candidate maximum true-term error no greater than1.05 times the smaller of fixed-rich and rich-then-variance maxima, plus absolute roundoff tolerance.
stress_mean_guard: Budget9 noise3 mean no greater than1.05 times the smaller fixed-rich/ablation mean, plus roundoff tolerance.
forecast_guard: At budget9 in both noises, all18 three-trajectory means must be available and no greater than5%; zero failed prediction slots.
cost_metric: Unchanged joint success at80% of all36 paired conditions; minimum saved budget5..9. Offline readout only; never online stopping.

paired_resampling.unit: parameter task; sample three tasks with replacement separately within each of six families
paired_resampling.interpretation: Descriptive percentile interval with only three tasks per family; not used to select the acquisition or claim calibrated probability.

zero_control_mean_rule: A required-improvement control mean <= absolute_roundoff_tolerance cannot establish any positive relative improvement; the improvement gate fails even when the candidate is also zero, and relative_improvement is null.
